title: Epstein's keycard access to Harvard evolutionary dynamics program

tellings.quote: And he was involved in the evolutionary dynamics uh biology sub program at Harvard. He had keycard access to that.

plain: Jeffrey Epstein is said to have been involved in an evolutionary dynamics program in biology at Harvard in the 2000s, and to have had keycard access to it. A philosopher named Jason Jorjani tells Michels this, passing on what he links to the scientists Robert Trivers and George Church. If true, it would put Epstein physically inside a Harvard research program, not only funding it from outside.
